subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: When `gateway.bind` is explicitly `tailnet` and no usable Tailnet address exists, should startup fail or preserve the current loopback-only fallback?
rationale: Both choices are defensible: fatal startup honors explicit configuration and avoids a silent mode change, while loopback fallback preserves local availability for existing installations; changing the current behavior is upgrade-sensitive.

options.title: Fail explicit tailnet startup
options.body: Return an actionable startup error for explicit `tailnet`, while keeping fallback behavior limited to `auto`.

options.title: Warn and remain loopback-only
options.body: Preserve local availability but emit a prominent warning that the requested Tailnet listener was not created.

options.title: Keep silent fallback
options.body: Retain current behavior without operator-visible failure or warning, prioritizing availability over explicit bind intent.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit tailnet startup
recommendation.body: Return an actionable startup error for explicit `tailnet`, while keeping fallback behavior limited to `auto`.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing review and timeline identify @steipete as the strongest owner for gateway startup and compatibility policy.
